title: Bias in, Bias out: Annotation Bias in Multilingual Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using inter-annotator agreement metrics (Cohen's Kappa, Fleiss' Kappa, Krippendorff's Alpha), demographic gap analysis between annotator groups, and evaluated empirically using Weak Ensemble Learning (WEL) on datasets with multiple human annotators.

Evaluated through multilingual model disagreement rates across parallel corpora, cultural inference techniques measuring L2 distance in cultural embedding spaces, and qualitative case studies analyzing cross-cultural disparities in hate speech and emotion recognition.
Evaluated by analyzing the impact of task framing and prompt phrasing, and measured theoretically by tracking the variance in annotator disagreement across iterative stages of guideline refinement.
